card.name: Start of "re" words in legal text
card.fires_on: Mostly the prefix "re" at the start of words like re-examination, re-baptizers and reprimanded, in old legal or historical prose. Also fires on scattered single words in similar passages.

modes.description: The piece "re" begins a word meaning doing something again, in legal or historical text.
